name: Onii-chan Jushinchuu
source:
Main character shares car hobby with his boss. One day they get in an accident damaging house of the boss. The house is co-owned, so protagonist has to shelter two girls for the time being.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公和上司有共同的汽车爱好。
某天两人出了事故，撞坏上司的房子。
房子由他人共有，因此主人公暂时得安置两名女孩。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
